steps: Run npm run moomoo:pkce-live-import from C:\\phios.
If no MOOMOO_CLIENT_ID or local .moomoo-auth/client.json exists, the helper dynamically registers a public OAuth client with redirect http://localhost:60355/callback.
The helper generates a new cryptographic state, code_verifier and S256 code_challenge for the session.
Your browser opens Moomoo's official authorization page. Approve only the quote/read access needed for this research import.
The localhost callback validates state, exchanges the code for tokens in memory, and immediately passes the access token only to the governed HISTORY_KLINE child process.
Access token, refresh token, authorization code and code_verifier are never printed or persisted. Only non-secret client_id metadata may be cached under gitignored .moomoo-auth/.
After successful import run npm run build:runtime-position-48:w8a:p2 and the relevant checks.
